summary: SSE keepalive trimming JSON metadata on resume, causing partial choice/metadata loss
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that after an transient network drop and SSE resume, the final choice's JSON metadata (choice-level 'finish_reason' and 'metadata' object) is truncated/trimmed. Impact: downstream client app treats partial metadata as malformed and drops the last sentence of responses and loses tool-calling hints. Environment: prod us-east (edge load-balanced by our streaming-proxy cluster).
impact: Customer-facing chat UI intermittently drops final sentence and loses tool-calling metadata for ~2% of resumed SSE sessions across a single customer account. This affects billing (increased retries) and product correctness.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Initiate a long-running generation (stream) against /v1/chat with streaming SSE on redwood-open-alpha-v1 in us-east
2) During token emission, induce a short network interruption (client closes TCP for ~200-600ms) simulating flaky mobile network
3) Allow client to reconnect and resume by re-subscribing with same session token/headers
4) Observe the final choice event and accompanying JSON metadata delivered by the server after resume
5) Repeat 50-100x to reproduce statistical occurrence (~1-3% seen in customer's traces)
observed_behavior: When resume occurs while the streaming-proxy is sending keepalive frames, the first resumed chunk sometimes has a truncated JSON metadata suffix (missing closing fields or truncated string). Client logs show 'unexpected end of JSON input' or partial 'finish_reason'.
expected_behavior: On resume, SSE stream sends complete token/choice payloads including intact metadata object and proper 'end' delimiter. Keepalives should not split JSON token boundaries in a way that causes truncation after reassembly.
logs: Customer-provided client log excerpt: ERROR: parseError at offset 874 - unexpected end of JSON input
Edge proxy logs (us-east-3a): connID=abcd1234 reconnect delta=412ms downstream-chunk-sizes=[128,64,512]
Serving runtime trace: request=rn-90812 tokenStream resumed at offset 4123; last-sent-chunk: "..." (length 512)
investigation_notes: 2026-02-28 15:20 - initial triage by Aisha: correlates customer trace with streaming-proxy keepalive bursts between 15:12-15:24 UTC

2026-02-28 18:05 - Marcus: observed fragmented SSE event boundaries in proxy logs where keepalive frames were interleaved with data frames; hypothesize proxy coalescing + chunk-truncation on reconnect path
Checked grafana: dashboard 'streaming.resend.rate' and 'sse.fragmentation.percent' show small spike for customer account during window
Reproducer script created in staging (sse-resume-repro.js) that toggles client socket; reproduces truncation reliably when keepalive interval set to 250ms and client reconnects within 300-600ms
Hypothesis: reverse-proxy (edge) may be issuing keepalive TLV frames that the client reinterprets on resume and server-side reassembly incorrectly drops trailing JSON suffix when re-linking fragments
Temporary investigation PR opened to add defensive reassembly/logging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/streaming-proxy/pull/412
mitigation: Short-term: recommend customer set client-side exponential backoff to 700ms before resume; increase SSE keepalive interval via per-customer proxy config to 1s to reduce interleaving chance. Applied per-account keepalive override for NarrativeLabs for 72 hours.
resolution_plan: 1) Add stricter event-boundary markers to SSE chunks for resume path (server-side change) 2) Harden streaming-proxy reassembly to buffer until JSON delimiter verified 3) Add end-to-end tests for keepalive+resume scenarios 4) Roll out fix behind canary and monitor 'sse.resume.json-errors' metric
resolution_estimate: Proposed fix in streaming-proxy v2.3.1 with canary by 2026-03-10; full rollout by 2026-03-17 after validation
resolution_notes: Workaround applied (keepalive override) reduced occurrence to <0.1% for the customer's replay window. Engineering PR for proxy reassembly in review.
